$comment: History, read by no rule. An earlier version of the zk2 core had an operation whose types are JSON Schema types answer a failed call with this envelope, encoded in the operation's `encoding`, JSON or CBOR. A failed call is now answered in core §7.5's error form (spec core.md §5.2), and a reply error under application/json or application/cbor is the transport's.

detail.description: With `app` only: the value of the operation's declared `error` type, inline.
